text.p: Merrill Lynch said in a report it had initiated coverage of Brazilian brewery Companhia Cervejaria Brahma with an accumulate rating in the intermediate term and buy rating in the long term.
-- said its earnings per share estimates for the company are 48.78 reais for 1997 and 57.34 reais for 1998.
-- said Brahma has solid management with a proven track record and in the past has proven to be shareholder-oriented.

-- said Brahma's intention to list its American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) on the New York Stock Exchange this week should help the company's multiples by improving the stock's liquidity and visibility.
-- Brahma today said it will list its stock on the NYSE on Wednesday following the approval of the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission of its Level Two ADR program.
-- Brahma preferred was up 1.71 percent at 775 reais on the Sao Paulo bourse.
